arabic text:
Ai azadaro aawo majlis mein, fatema intezaar karti haine
Ai azadaron suno keh rahi hai sayeda
Har ek chaahe waale ko bakshwa dungi,
Mere hussain ko rote raho dua dungi
english translation text:
O mourners, come to the majlis; Fatema awaits you.
O mourners, listen—the Sayyada is saying:
“I will seek forgiveness for every lover;
keep weeping for my Hussain, and I will pray for you.”

arabic text: Tum apne ghar me aza khaane jab sajawo ge, jaza rasool se iski zaroor paoge\nKhuda bhi razi rahega ali bhi aur mein bhi gham apna bhul ke aashur jab manaoge\nTumhare dil ke hare ek zakhm ki dawa dungi
english translation text: When you establish a mourning place in your homes, you will surely receive its reward from the Prophet.\nAllah, Ali and I will all be pleased when you put aside your own grief and commemorate Ashura.\nI will grant a cure for every wound in your hearts.

arabic text: Ajeeb haal se awungi me sare mehshar, ke lawungi mein waha god mein hussain ka sar\nMein lawungi mere abbas ke kate huwe haath, to saath lashae asgher bhi aur hasan ka jigar\nKhuda se baba ki ummat ko bakhshwa dungi
english translation text: I will arrive upon the plain of Judgement in a wondrous state, carrying Hussain’s head in my lap.\nI will bring Abbas’s severed hands, Asghar’s body, and Hasan’s wounded liver.\nI will ask Allah to forgive my father’s nation.

arabic text: Bawaqte asr guluwe hussain kat ta tha, pisar ke gird phiri roohe fatema Zahra\nNidaahe fatema aathi thi aah wa wayla, ke chaki pees ke maine hussain ko pala\nKaro na qatl isse mein tumhe dua dungi
english translation text: At the time of Asr, as Hussain’s throat was being cut, Fatema Zahra’s spirit circled her son.\nHer cry rose: “Alas, tragedy! I ground grain and raised Hussain with my own hands.\nDo not kill him; I will pray for you.”

arabic text: Meri sakina aur zainab ki sab kaneez sune, wasiyat ek meri hai yeh dhyaan me rakhein\nKabhi jo zikr ho zainab ki be ridai ka, to ek lamha bhi khudko wo berida na karein\nMe tumko betiyan zainab si bahaya dungi
english translation text: Let every servant of my Sakina and Zainab hear and remember this instruction:\nwhenever Zainab’s loss of veil is mentioned, let her not remain unveiled even for a moment.\nI will grant you daughters with the modesty of Zainab.

arabic text: Jo umr bhar mere bachon ka nawha khan hoga, ba roze hashr wo utna hi shadman hoga\nJo nohe likthe rahe mazhar abidi yuhi qalam yeh taba qayamt yuhi rawa hoga\nHar ek bayt pe jannat mein ghar dila dungi
english translation text: Whoever recites laments for my children throughout life will be joyful on the Day of Judgement.\nMay Mazhar Abidi’s pen continue writing elegies like these until the end of time.\nFor every verse, I will grant a home in Paradise.
